skill_flagged.problem: The recorded step assumes the SKU is known without checking the catalog, which contradicts the rule that the PO is the source of truth and the SKU must be looked up in the catalog.
skill_flagged.correction: Look up the product in the catalog using the product name from the PO and enter its SKU.

correction.text: When a PO splits an item into several sizes, enter one line per size, and check that every listed size has been entered before submitting.
correction.reason: The correction aligns with the principle that the PO is the source of truth. The original steps did not explicitly address cases where a PO splits an item into multiple sizes. The correction clarifies that each size should be entered as a separate line item, and that all sizes must be accounted for before submission. This ensures the order matches the PO exactly, which is consistent with the stated rules and the original demonstration.

skill: Select the customer account the PO is from, using the customer name from the PO.
Copy the PO number exactly as written from the PO.
Enter the ship-by date from the PO in the required date format.
Look up the product in the catalog using the product name from the PO and enter its SKU.
Pick the color the PO asks for, using the color name from the PO.
Pick the size the PO asks for, using the size from the PO. If the product does not have sizes, use N/A.
Enter the quantity for this product/color/size combination, converting units like dozens to a number.
Use the price from the PO for the unit price; if none is given, use the catalog price.
When a PO splits an item into several sizes, enter one line per size.
Check that every listed size has been entered before submitting the order.
Add one row per product/color/size combination as specified in the PO.
Submit the order only when every line item matches the PO exactly.
